action.objective: Verify a second candidate to compare with Qc8+, then commit the better move.
action.rationale: f5c8 is verified commit_ready: exact score 47 at depth 4, Qc8+ wins the b7 pawn and the a8 rook sits trapped with no legal retreat (b8/a8 covered by queen, f8 bishop blocked). But the earlier broad search also flagged g2g3 = 47 (bound upper, so possibly worse, and it is already a pawn move that ignores the Black rook on a3 and the passed a-pawn). We have 1611 verification nodes and 2 analyses left; before committing I want a like-for-like check of the most plausible quiet alternative. Candidate b1b7 is tempting (immediate pawn grab) but leaves our queen on f5 hanging to the g6 rook's pressure and does not address a3a2. I will verify g2g3 (or if it fails to compare, b1b7) at depth 4 with the available verification nodes.
